requirement:
Create a small Go module using only the standard library. Use exactly this go.mod:
module example.com/task

go 1.22

Put the implementation in `lib/reverse.go` (package `lib`) and your own tests in `lib/reverse_test.go` (package `lib`, `go test`). No third-party modules.

SPEC: Implement `func Reverse(s string) string`. Return s reversed by Unicode characters (runes), not bytes.
